name: Chase
source:
"Do you think Zhang Lei will abandon you if he finds out who you really are?"

He is a detective in the Tsim Sha Tsui Police Department. He is investigating the murder of Lau Ka Tung together with Sam. In fact, he is also a spy from the HH brothers.

[From [url=http://www.rpgdl.org/rsl2/en.html#character]official site[/url]]
